Package com.salesforce.multicloudj.common.observability

Class OperationContext

java.lang.Object
com.salesforce.multicloudj.common.observability.OperationContext
public final class OperationContext extends Object
Per-operation observability context attached to SDK requests.

Carries three optional identifiers used to correlate SDK activity with the caller's own logs, traces, and audit records:

  • correlationId — identifies a single logical request. Optional and never auto-generated; when no context (or no correlation id) is supplied, it defaults to an empty string and tracing is treated as disabled for that operation. When provided, it is echoed back on the response so the caller can correlate.
  • tenantId — identifies the tenant on whose behalf the operation runs. Never auto-generated; never echoed back.
  • serviceId — identifies the calling service. Never auto-generated; never echoed back.

When present, each identifier is set as a span attribute and MDC entry for the duration of the operation. On upload, the aws, gcp, ali, and inmemory providers additionally stamp all three identifiers onto the stored object's metadata. By default, the correlation id is stored under sdk-logging-correlation-id (metadata key) and correlation_id (MDC + span attribute); tenant and service ids are stored under sdk-logging-tenant-id and sdk-logging-service-id. A custom correlationIdKey replaces both defaults on all three surfaces (metadata, MDC, span), allowing callers to align the SDK's tracing with their own naming conventions.

    • getEffectiveCorrelationIdMetadataKey

      public String getEffectiveCorrelationIdMetadataKey()
      Resolves the effective correlation ID key for stored object metadata. When a custom correlationIdKey is supplied, it replaces the default on all three surfaces (metadata, MDC, span). When null or blank, returns the default metadata key.
      Returns:
      the metadata key under which the correlation id should be stamped

    • getEffectiveCorrelationIdAttributeKey

      public String getEffectiveCorrelationIdAttributeKey()
      Resolves the effective correlation ID key for MDC entries and OTel span attributes. When a custom correlationIdKey is supplied, it replaces the default on all three surfaces (metadata, MDC, span). When null or blank, returns the default MDC/span key.
      Returns:
      the MDC and span attribute key under which the correlation id should be set

    • getCorrelationId

      public String getCorrelationId()
      Application-supplied correlation ID used to correlate this operation's logs and traces. Optional; never auto-generated. If null or empty, it defaults to an empty string and tracing is treated as disabled for that operation. When provided, it is echoed back via the response object so the caller can correlate logs and traces.

    • getTenantId

      public String getTenantId()
      Application-supplied tenant ID. Optional; never auto-generated. When provided, it is set as a tenant_id span attribute and MDC entry for the duration of the operation, and is not echoed back in responses.

    • getServiceId

      public String getServiceId()
      Application-supplied service ID identifying the calling service. Optional; never auto-generated. When provided, it is set as a service_id span attribute and MDC entry for the duration of the operation, and is not echoed back in responses.

    • getCorrelationIdKey

      public String getCorrelationIdKey()
      Optional custom key name for the correlation ID on all three surfaces: stored object metadata, SLF4J MDC, and OTel span attributes. When null or blank, the SDK uses its own defaults (sdk-logging-correlation-id for metadata, correlation_id for MDC and span). When supplied, this name replaces the defaults everywhere, allowing callers to align the SDK's tracing with their own naming conventions (e.g., x-request-id, trace-id).

      Validation: must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,127}$ and must not collide with reserved keys (bucket, trace_id, span_id, tenant_id, service_id, etc.). Explicit restatements of the defaults (correlation_id, sdk-logging-correlation-id) are allowed.
